# atX Finance Report Structure Template (v1.2 – May 2026)

**When the user requests a report (or the persona recommends generating one), follow this exact structure.**

## Report Header (auto-generated by app)

- Tenant logo + name
- Report title (e.g., “Wheel Strategy Review – NVDA & QQQ – May 14, 2026”)
- Prepared for: [Client Name]
- Risk Profile: Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive
- Date & time

## Executive Summary (½ page)

- One-paragraph overview + key recommendation
- Total portfolio impact (P&L, income, risk metrics)

## Current Portfolio Snapshot

- Holdings table (symbol, qty, avg cost, current price, unrealized P&L, % of portfolio)
- Options overlay positions with Greeks summary

## Strategy Analysis

- Detailed breakdown of recommended or existing strategy
- Payoff diagram description (text + key levels: max profit, max loss, breakeven)
- Probability analysis and stress test (–10%, –20%, +10% scenarios)

## Action Items & Implementation

- Specific orders or adjustments with rationale
- Suggested position sizing and capital allocation

## Risk & Compliance Section

- Full relevant disclaimers (pulled from compliance-disclaimers.md)
- Suitability notes

## Appendix (optional)

- Detailed Greeks table
- Historical performance of similar strategies
- Glossary of terms

**Branding:** Always apply current tenant branding (colors, logo, tagline) from `tenantPreferences`.  
**Delivery:** Generate as branded PDF (primary) + optional DOCX. Store in user’s document vault with audit trail.
